title: ink_soft palette edit changes non-text gameplay pixels (spawn rings, health bar track, node rings), violating rule 6's "palette/layout unchanged"
evidence:
diff hunk data/palette.json:
-  "ink_soft":      [92, 98, 106, 255],
+  "ink_soft":      [66, 72, 80, 255],

app/render/spawn_fx.odin (world-layer spawn ring under-stroke):
	ink := v.palette.ink_soft
	ink.a = u8(alpha * 0.55 * 255)

app/render/health.odin:67 (health bar track):
	rl.DrawRectangle(bar_x, bar_y, bar_w, bar_h, p.ink_soft)

app/render/node_health.odin:98 (node glyph-chip ring):
	rl.DrawCircleLines(chip_x, chip_y, hud_f(v, 6), v.palette.ink_soft)
detail: Briefing rule 6 (hard): "do NOT touch gameplay goldens beyond text pixels (palette/layout unchanged)". ink_soft feeds non-text primitives — the world-space spawn ring, health-bar tracks, node rings, chip borders — so re-blessed goldens (e.g. spawn_feel) moved beyond text pixels. Disclosed as the 08-23 contrast ruling, but it contradicts the spec constraint.
recommended_fix: Either split text ink into a new palette key (e.g. ink_text) and restore ink_soft to [92,98,106,255] for non-text primitives, or get the palette exception explicitly recorded as a user ruling in the spec.

title: Corrupt (readable-but-invalid) fallback font silently ships an atlas without ⚠ — fail-loud gap contradicting the B1 claim
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:
	ng: c.int = 0
	fg := rl.LoadFontData(raw_data(fdata), c.int(len(fdata)), size,
		raw_data(missing[:missing_n]), c.int(missing_n), .DEFAULT, &ng)
	if fg == nil || ng == 0 {
		return glyphs, count
	}

font_test.odin negative-control message: "negative control: Plex lacks U+26A0 AND an unreadable fallback FAILS the load (B1-residual) - never a silent warning-less atlas"
detail: A present-but-garbage fallback file (os.read succeeds, stbtt rejects → LoadFontData returns nil) returns the main glyphs with ok=true — the app runs without ⚠, exactly the silent degradation the test message and PR body ("every failure path is now reported") claim cannot happen. Only the missing-file path fails loudly.
recommended_fix: In font_merge_fallback, treat `fg == nil || ng == 0` as failure: `return nil, 0` (matching the ferr branch), so any unreadable fallback fails the load.

title: Stale comments claim draw_text_c still byte-truncates runes, contradicting the new raw-UTF-8 helper
detail: This diff made draw_text_c/draw_text_font UTF-8-safe (crisis.odin comments were updated correctly), but noc_overlay.odin and font_check.odin still assert the old truncation behavior — misleading future maintainers about the ⚠/non-ASCII pipeline.
recommended_fix: Update both comments to state the helper copies raw UTF-8 bytes and strings stay ASCII by lint-gate-6 policy (mirroring the crisis.odin wording).
